tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window background. Near-black with a trace of blue, close enough to black that you only see the blue next to a pure black swatch. Concrete theme: overcast grey.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised sections, module backgrounds, header strip, resting button fill.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: 1px separators, inner strokes, unfilled value arcs, fader tracks. Decoration only, about 1.3:1 on panel. Use edge-hi for any outline that must be seen.

tokens.name: edge-hi
tokens.usage: Outline of any control that must be seen (button border when off, fader thumb outline, focus ring). 3:1 or better on bg and panel in both themes.

tokens.name: spray
tokens.usage: Primary accent, the color of a fresh tag. Active value arcs, selected states, the corner notch, meter nominal zone. Fill, or text 18px and up. Small text uses spray-hi.

tokens.name: spray-hi
tokens.usage: Small accent text (labels in the on state, section marks) on panel, bg and spray-wash. 4.5:1 or better on all three.

tokens.name: spray-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a button in its on state, laid over panel.

tokens.name: on-spray
tokens.usage: Text or glyph on a solid spray fill. 5:1 on spray in both themes.

tokens.name: rain
tokens.usage: Secondary accent, the cyan of rain on neon. Modulation, links between controls, the low end of a meter, the drift tick on knobs. Never used for small text in Concrete. Plugins may re-tint one accent; rain is the one that stays.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Labels and values on bg and panel.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Units, hints, inactive labels, footer version string on bg and panel.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Signal present, input locked, saved. Always paired with a word or a dot glyph.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Hazard yellow. Near clip, value outside the stock range, compatibility warning, the stripe on stencil markings. Paired with a triangle glyph.

tokens.name: clip
tokens.usage: Clipping and hard errors. The source spec gave no red, so this one was chosen to hold 5:1 on bg in Night. Paired with the bracket glyph on meters.

tokens.name: knob-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the knob body and fader thumb radial gradient.

tokens.name: knob-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the knob body and fader thumb radial gradient.

families.display: "Big Shoulders Stencil Display", "Saira Stencil One", Impact, sans-serif
families.tag: "Rubik Spray Paint", "Big Shoulders Stencil Display", sans-serif

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Plugin name in the header strip. Uppercase, set by the stylesheet.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: System name on the cover and splash screens. Uppercase, with the spray offset.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control labels. Set uppercase in the stylesheet, not in the string.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headers, uppercase, next to the spray bar.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Secondary lines under body text, in ink-muted.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Knob and fader values. Tabular figures on.

styles.name: value-lg
styles.usage: Large readouts: tempo, peak meter number, preset index.

styles.name: mono-xs
styles.usage: Version string in the bottom-right footer.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: The sprayed signature next to the version string in the footer. Lowercase, one use per window, rotated -4 degrees.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Fine detail: gap between a knob and its arc, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Base grid step. Gap between controls in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Minimum distance from the window edge to any control. Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Header strip height.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Default knob diameter, cover margins.

tokens.name: knob-sm
tokens.usage: Small knob diameter.

tokens.name: knob-lg
tokens.usage: Large knob diameter.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and toggles.

tokens.name: notch
tokens.usage: Length of the diagonal notch in the top-left corner of the window. It is 11. Every earlier note said 12. Leave it.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Main plugin window.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Inner panels, buttons, tooltips, dropdowns.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Small controls: tick caps, thumb ends, inputs.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hover lift on panels, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: spray-offset
tokens.usage: Second-pass offset behind display type, as if sprayed twice. Titles and the cover name only.
